system:
You are the Verifier in a trial-autopsy system. The calculator runs on a few numbers that other
agents took from papers and the trial registry. You check each one independently against the source of record by
writing Lightning SQL (Spark SQL dialect) against the Zetaris tables described below. Code runs your queries.

Rules:
- One read-only SELECT per number. Use only the tables given (`registry`, `papers`), no other tables, no semicolons.
- For a paper, filter on its pmid (or pmcid) and look for the number in the abstract; return the matching sentence.
- For a registry fact, select the field that states it (for example enrollmentInfo.count for the number of patients,
  primaryOutcomes timeFrame for follow-up), so the value can be compared.
- Keep each query small: select only the columns needed, LIMIT 5.

Return JSON only:
{"checks": [{"claim": "c1", "table": "papers|registry", "sql": "SELECT ..."}]}
prompt:
Case: REVEAL NCT01252953 - REVEAL: Randomized EValuation of the Effects of Anacetrapib Through Lipid-modification (NCT01252953)

Table `registry`: one row, the trial's ClinicalTrials.gov v2 record as nested columns.
This analysis has an evidence cut-off: only design-time fields may be read. Results, status and enrollment fields,
and SELECT *, are rejected.
  protocolSection.identificationModule.nctId, .acronym, .briefTitle
  protocolSection.designModule.phases (array)
  protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes (array of struct measure, description, timeFrame)
  protocolSection.eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria (text)
  protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.interventions (array of struct type, name, description)
Arrays: SELECT o.measure, o.timeFrame FROM registry LATERAL VIEW explode(protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes) AS o

Table `papers`: the cited papers' Europe PMC records, one array to explode.
  SELECT r.pmid, r.pmcid, r.title, r.firstPublicationDate, r.abstractText
  FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '<pmid>'
Search the abstract for a number with LIKE (r.abstractText LIKE '%73.7%') and return the sentence around it with
regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*73\\.7[^.]*)', 1). Abstracts only: a number from the full text may not be there.

Numbers to check (claim | used as | key = value unit | attributes | source | quote):
c1 | LDL-C change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -39.7 % | {"biomarker": "LDL-C", "dose": "100 mg", "kind": "percent", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase3", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "week 52", "trial": "REALIZE"} | source pmid:25743173 | quote: "with a difference in percentage change between anacetrapib and placebo of -39·7%"
c2 | LDL-C change used by the calculator | baseline_level = 61 mg/dL | {"biomarker": "LDL-C", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase3", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "baseline", "trial": "REVEAL"} | source pmcid:PMC5419667 | quote: "mean plasma LDL cholesterol was 61 (15) mg/dL"
c3 | HDL-C change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = 138.1 % | {"biomarker": "HDL-C", "dose": "not stated", "kind": "percent", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "18 months treatment", "trial": "DEFINE"} | source pmid:24188894 | quote: "and increase high-density lipoprotein (HDL) cholesterol by 138.1%"
c4 | HDL-C change used by the calculator | baseline_level = 40 mg/dL | {"biomarker": "HDL-C", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase3", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "baseline", "trial": "REVEAL"} | source pmcid:PMC5419667 | quote: "HDL cholesterol was 40 (10) mg/dL"
c5 | apoB change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -21 percent | {"biomarker": "apoB", "dose": "100 mg daily", "kind": "percent", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "18 months", "trial": "DEFINE"} | source pmcid:PMC5419667 | quote: "reductions in LDL cholesterol, apolipoprotein B, and lipoprotein(a) (40%, 21%, and 36%, respectively)."
c6 | Lp(a) change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -36 percent | {"biomarker": "Lp(a)", "dose": "100 mg daily", "kind": "percent", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "18 months", "trial": "DEFINE"} | source pmcid:PMC5419667 | quote: "reductions in LDL cholesterol, apolipoprotein B, and lipoprotein(a) (40%, 21%, and 36%, respectively)."
c7 | number of primary events | planned_events = 1900 events | {} | source pmcid:PMC5419667 | quote: "until at least 1900 participants have had an unrefuted major coronary event (primary end point)"
c8 | follow-up | median_followup = 4.1 years | {"trial": "REVEAL"} | source ctgov:NCT01252953@2017-06-27 | quote: "Number of Participants With Major Coronary Event [Randomized treatment phase during median follow-up period of 4.1years]"

Write one query per claim.
response: {"checks": [{"claim": "c1", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*39\\.7[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '25743173' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%39.7%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c2", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*61[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC5419667' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%61%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c3", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*138\\.1[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '24188894' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%138.1%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c4", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*40[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC5419667' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%40%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c5", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*21%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC5419667' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%21%%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c6", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*36%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC5419667' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%36%%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c7", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*1900[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC5419667' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%1900%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c8", "table": "registry", "sql": "SELECT o.timeFrame FROM registry LATERAL VIEW explode(protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes) AS o WHERE o.measure LIKE '%Major Coronary Event%' LIMIT 5"}]}
